title: Time bound for buffered composition
statement: Let $F,G$ be finite Turing machines over the binary alphabet, and let $x,y,z$ be binary words and $s,t$ natural numbers. If $F$ computes $y$ from $x$ in exactly $s$ steps and $G$ computes $z$ from $y$ in exactly $t$ steps, then their buffered composition computes $z$ from $x$ in exactly $s+|y|+2+t$ steps.
replaced: Let $F$ and $G$ be deterministic machines, and suppose $F$ computes $y$ from $x$ within $s$ steps and $G$ computes $z$ from $y$ within $t$ steps. Then the buffered composition of $F$ and $G$ computes $z$ from $x$ within $s + |y| + 2 + t$ steps.
